parameters.name: leave_type_id

schema.description: Return only the leaves of these leave types. Despite the singular name it takes a list.

parameters.description: Return only the leaves that had already started by this date (start date on or before it). Usable on its own; pair it with `from` for a window.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Return only the leaves that had not finished before this date, meaning they end on or after it or have no end date at all. Usable on its own; pair it with `to` for a window.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: Retrieve only active leaves
parameters.name: only_active

parameters.description: Whether to include deleted leaves (not included by default if not specified)
parameters.name: include_deleted_leaves

parameters.description: Set to true for leaves that were approved, false for leaves that were rejected. Leave it unset for every leave whatever its decision. Combining `approved: true` with `include_pending: true` returns approved and still-pending leaves together.
parameters.name: approved

parameters.description: Set to true to include leaves still awaiting a decision. On its own it returns ONLY the pending ones; alongside `approved: true` it returns approved and pending together.
parameters.name: include_pending

parameters.description: Retrieve leave types
parameters.name: include_leave_type

parameters.description: Retrieve leave duration
parameters.name: include_duration

parameters.description: Retrieve the per-day breakdown of the leave's duration (`duration_by_day_attributes`)
parameters.name: include_duration_by_day

parameters.description: Set to true for leaves whose leave type counts as worked time, false for those that do not. Leave it unset to get both.
parameters.name: type_is_workable

parameters.description: Set to true for leaves whose leave type is paid, false for unpaid ones. Leave it unset to get both.
parameters.name: type_is_payable

parameters.description: Caps the per-day duration walk at this date. For endless leaves (`finish_on = nil`) it pins the walk end; for closed leaves whose `finish_on` sits past this date it truncates the walk. Never extends a leave past its real `finish_on`. Must fall inside the read window (from/to or overlaps_range_from/overlaps_range_to).
parameters.name: forced_finish_on

parameters.description: Records per page, up to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The next cursor returned by an earlier page.
parameters.name: after_id

data.description: The response returned by the service.
Data.

approved.description: Tri-state approval status — true = approved, false = rejected, null = pending approval

company_id.description: ID of the company the leave belongs to

created_at.description: The created at date of the leave

days_taken.description: Number of days taken for paid leave. Reflects the summed per-day used total when the per-day breakdown is computed; otherwise the leave's calendar-day duration.

deleted_at.description: The date when the leave was deleted

duration_attributes.description: The duration attributes of the leave

duration_by_day_attributes.description: Per-day breakdown of the leave's workable and used units, keyed by calendar date. Populated only when the read requests `include_duration_by_day=true`; null otherwise.

employee_full_name.description: The full name of the employee taking the leave

employee_id.description: ID of the employee taking the leave

finish_on.description: Last day of the leave (inclusive); null while an open-ended leave has no end yet

half_day.description: Which half of the day a half-day leave covers — `beginning_of_day` or `end_of_day`; null for full-day leaves

hours_amount_in_cents.description: Total hours the leave consumes, in hundredths of an hour (e.g. 800 = 8 hours); set for hourly leaves

leave_type_id.description: ID of the leave type this leave is of

leave_type_name.description: Denormalised name of the leave type

reason.description: The reason provided by the employee for taking the leave

start_time.description: The start time of the leave

updated_at.description: The updated at date of the leave

next_cursor.description: Pass to the continuation input to read the next page.
